title: Etale and Zariski cohomology agree on schemes with strictly henselian local rings
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme all of whose local rings $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ are strictly henselian [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], and let $\mathcal F$ be an abelian sheaf on the small etale site $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Let $\epsilon:X_{\Et}\to X_{\rm Zar}$ be the morphism of sites given by the inclusion functor $u:X_{\rm Zar}\to X_{\Et}$, $U\mapsto(U\hookrightarrow X)$, from the small Zariski site [def-sc-zariski-site] [lem-weil-pbc-zariski-etale-inclusion-morphism-of-sites], [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], with direct image $\epsilon_*\mathcal F$, $(\epsilon_*\mathcal F)(U)=\mathcal F(U\hookrightarrow X)$, an abelian sheaf on $X_{\rm Zar}$, inverse image $\epsilon^{-1}$ and counit $\varepsilon_{\mathcal F}:\epsilon^{-1}\epsilon_*\mathcal F\to\mathcal F$ of $\epsilon^{-1}\dashv\epsilon_*$. For $q\ge0$ let the comparison map $c^q:H^q(X_{\rm Zar},\epsilon_*\mathcal F)\to H^q(X_{\Et},\mathcal F)$ be the pullback $\epsilon^*:H^q(X_{\rm Zar},\epsilon_*\mathcal F)\to H^q(X_{\Et},\epsilon^{-1}\epsilon_*\mathcal F)$ of [lem-weil-pbc-site-cohomology-pullback] (for the final object $X$ of $X_{\rm Zar}$, $u(X)=X$) followed by the map induced by $\varepsilon_{\mathcal F}$ (Zariski cohomology [def-sc-zariski-cohomology], etale cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]); in degree $0$ it is the identity of $\mathcal F(X)$. Then $c^q$ is an isomorphism for every $q\ge0$.

proof.text: Apply strictHenselian_cohomology_locally_zero to the difference s-t in positive object cohomology on U, at each x in U. It supplies x in V subset U with restriction(s-t)=0. Restriction is additive, so restriction(s)=restriction(t). These witnesses show that the equalizer sieve of any two sections is covering, which is precisely local injectivity of the zero endomorphism.

Use zariski_etale_canonical_leray with the resulting local-injectivity family, the supplied functor, underlying-functor equality, continuity, and the three characterizing clauses hfstar. It proves that pullback followed by the counit is invertible on every open in every degree. Set V=top and rewrite c q using hc q.

split_report.summary: Split along Stacks 09AX: (1) epsilon from the inclusion functor (new lem-weil-pbc-zariski-etale-inclusion-morphism-of-sites, Sites 00X6) and identification of the comparison map with the Leray edge map; (2) R^q epsilon_* F = sheafified presheaf U -> H^q(U,F) (new lem-weil-pbc-site-higher-direct-image-sheafified-presheaf, site version of 072W; the existing lem-weil-pbc-higher-direct-image-sheafified-presheaf is only the etale-to-etale case); (3) classes of positive degree are Zariski locally zero, by the colimit over neighbourhoods (new lem-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology-local-ring-colimit, 03Q6/09YQ + 03F3) and vanishing over strictly henselian local rings (new lem-weil-pbc-strictly-henselian-etale-acyclic, 03QO final assertion; the existing lem-weil-pbc-strictly-henselian-sections-stalk is only Gamma = stalk); (4) hence the sheafification vanishes (new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-site-sheafification-iso-locally-bijective, W_iff_isLocallyBijective), done locally rather than via stalks to avoid a stalk node; (5) degenerate Leray (new lem-weil-pbc-site-leray-degenerate, 0733(1); lemma-weil-pbc-leray-acyclicity is the abstract acyclic-resolution lemma and is left for that node's own split). Statement corrected: the clause 'with the canonical identification epsilon^{-1} epsilon_* F = F for this inclusion' is false for a general scheme (the counit is not an isomorphism, e.g. for a sheaf with sections only on non-trivial finite etale covers); the comparison map is now defined as the pullback followed by the counit; lem-weil-pbc-zariski-etale-inclusion-morphism-of-sites added to stmt_deps since the statement presupposes that epsilon is a morphism of sites. Stacks typos noted: 'x in X' for 'x in S', 'higher direct images of R^p epsilon_* F' for 'the higher direct images R^p epsilon_* F'.

reviewed.note: STATEMENT CORRECTED: the former 'canonical identification epsilon^{-1} epsilon_* F = F' is false in general; the comparison map is now defined as pullback followed by the counit (identity in degree 0), which is what the citer gabber-criterion uses. 5 steps following Stacks 09AX: the morphism of sites (new unsplit 00X6 node) and the groups; R^q epsilon_* F as the sheafified presheaf (new unsplit 072W node for sites); positive-degree classes Zariski-locally zero via the colimit formula (new unsplit 03Q6/09YQ node) and the vanishing over strictly henselian local rings (new unsplit 03QO node); sheafification of a locally bijective map (new composed Mathlib leaf, LocallyBijective.lean:114/153 and Localization.lean:80 verified by L); degenerate Leray (new unsplit 0733 (1) node).

theorem strictHenselian_zariski_etale_comparison
    {X : Scheme.{u + 1}}
    (hX : ∀ x : X, IsStrictlyHenselianLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (i : X.Opens ⥤ X.Etale)
    (hi_inclusion : i ⋙ Scheme.Etale.forget X = X.restrictFunctor)
    (hi : i.IsContinuous (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
      X.smallEtaleTopology)
    [HasSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    [HasSheafify X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]
    [HasExt
      (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [HasExt (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [(sheafPullback i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).Additive]
    (fstar : ∀ (p : ℕ) (V : X.Opens)
      (A : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}),
      Sheaf.H' A p V ⟶
        Sheaf.H' ((sheafPullback i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).obj A)
          p (i.obj V))
    (hfstar : (∀ (p : ℕ) (V : X.Opens) (A A' : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (φ : A ⟶ A'),
        ((Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) p).map φ).app
          (op V) ≫
            fstar p V A' =
          fstar p V A ≫
            ((Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor X.smallEtaleTopology p).map
              ((sheafPullback i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
                (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).map φ)).app
                  (op (i.obj V))) ∧
      (∀ (S : ShortComplex (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
        (hS : S.ShortExact)
        (hS' : (S.map (sheafPullback i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology)).ShortExact)
        (p : ℕ) (V : X.Opens) (x : Sheaf.H' S.X₃ p V),
        (fstar (p + 1) V S.X₁).hom (Abelian.Ext.comp x hS.extClass rfl) =
          Abelian.Ext.comp ((fstar p V S.X₃).hom x) hS'.extClass rfl) ∧
      (∀ (V : X.Opens) (A : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
        (x : Sheaf.H' A 0 V),
        ((Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀ ((fstar 0 V A).hom x)).hom.app (op (i.obj V))).hom
            (((toSheafify X.smallEtaleTopology
              (yoneda.obj (i.obj V) ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free)).app (op (i.obj V))).hom
                (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 (i.obj V)))) =
          (((sheafAdjunctionContinuous i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
            (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).unit.app A).hom.app
              (op V)).hom
            (((Abelian.Ext.addEquiv₀ x).hom.app (op V)).hom
              (((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
                (yoneda.obj V ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free)).app (op V)).hom
                  (FreeAbelianGroup.of (𝟙 V))))))
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (c : ∀ q : ℕ,
      Sheaf.H'
          ((i.sheafPushforwardContinuous (AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
            (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).obj F)
          q ⊤ ⟶
        Sheaf.H' F q (i.obj ⊤))
    (hc : ∀ q : ℕ, c q =
      fstar q ⊤
          ((i.sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
            (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).obj F) ≫
        ((Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor X.smallEtaleTopology q).map
          ((sheafAdjunctionContinuous i AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
            (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) X.smallEtaleTopology).counit.app F)).app
              (op (i.obj ⊤))) :
    ∀ q : ℕ, IsIso (c q)
